text:
ASM::policy
Description
Returns the name of the ASM policy that was applied on the request.
It can be used to detect which CPM rules are applied or ASM::enable
commands are applied on a request.
Syntax
ASM
::
policy
Examples
when
ASM_REQUEST_BLOCKING
{
log
local0.
"The request was blocked using the [ASM::policy] policy"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ASM_REQUEST_DONE, ASM_REQUEST_VIOLATION, ASM_REQUEST_BLOCKING, ASM_RESPONSE_VIOLATION
Introduced: BIGIP-11.4.0
